properties.description:
Integrate the accepted Activity board, truthful node editor, persistent Pi-backed chat, shared annotation system and immutable three-repository review preview through their owning APIs. Resolve independent architecture and implementation review findings; remove replaced code within scope while preserving unrelated user changes.

Verification: full configured repository checks, source boundary review, actual UI screenshots and an ordinary isolated populated buildspace. Cover durable restart, stale writes, invariant rejection, annotation context/delivery and the agent edit/check/review loop. Complete human/tool parity and polished node/text diffs remain explicitly deferred. Present the result for user review; this implementation walkthrough does not claim the user's MVP acceptance.
